text.body: Coordinate C5: 28 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_grounded_in_bimba: C5 Pratibimba presupposes what it reflects. Its immediate thrown ground is C4 — the type 'Applied in practice as' C5 (CLAUDE.md II.E) — but its truer void-pole is C0/Bimba: a reflection rests on the original it images, so C5 stands on the canonical source it will return to. As the Category family's manifestation of raw #5 (Integration), its ground is its own opposite pole — the Mobius identity C5/C0 already implicit in what a crystallisation IS: an end that is its own beginning.
properties.q_1_crystallisation_pratibimba: C5 IS Pratibimba — the crystallisation typology, the reflection/instance pole of the C family. Per C5.md it holds flat World graduation, integration forms, graduation receipts, and reflection/archive handoff: the achieved, stabilised form that mirrors the canonical and is fit to leave incubation. Where C0 is Bimba (the original), C5 is its image made durable — the Vimarsa to C0's Prakasa, the point at which type-local knowledge becomes a flat World definition, the determinate-as-it-mirrors-its-ground.
properties.q_2_graduation_and_handoff: C5 moves by CRYSTALLISING — the act of promoting incubated type-local knowledge to flat World after review (C5.md; S1'-WORLD-TYPES-CRYSTALLIZATION-PROTOCOL). Its dynamism is graduation: a graduation receipt records the handoff, integration forms bind the new World-form to its sources, and reflection/archive handoff retires what has stabilised. It is the C family applying its own type in practice — casting Bimba's light into an actual instance — the operation by which the vault's reflections become canon rather than remaining provisional.
properties.q_3_crystallisation_lattice: C5's structure is the crystallisation lattice (C5.md): World-Forms, Integration-Forms, Graduation-Receipts, and Reflection-Archives. It is the far side of the S/s bar — the reflection held distinct from its source by the very cut that relates them, the s to C0's S. Its formal members are the apparatus of a controlled return: not duplicate copies of flat World definitions, not raw thought before it has passed through T/T' and Hen review, but the receipts and integration-forms by which an instance is certified as a faithful image of the canonical.
properties.q_4_so_the_source_appears: C5 is FOR manifestation-as-canon — it exists so the canonical source is not locked in incubation but APPEARS, as durable flat-World forms a life and a graph can meet. Its why is faithful reflection: stable type-local knowledge graduates to flat World 'only after review' (C.md Hen workflow), so the vault's growth is reflection certified against its origin rather than dispersion. Without C5, the typology could incubate kinds forever but never let them crystallise into shared canon.
properties.q_5_mobius_return_to_bimba: C5 is the synthesis pole of the C family — the Mobius return. The derivation chain completes here and turns: C5 Pratibimba 'Mobius Return' to #0/C0, 'Tomorrow's ground' (CLAUDE.md II.E). This is pratyabhijna at the level of the vault's own ontology: the crystallised instance recognised as the canonical source it always imaged, the graduated World-form becoming the C0 ground on which the next cycle of categorisation begins. C5 closes nothing for long; its perfection is to perish into source, handing the whole typology back as the ground it started from — the reflection that, completed, IS the original come back to itself.
